data.name: Cassaria
data.gender_notes: Cassaria is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Cassaria is derived from the Latin word 'Cassarius', meaning 'Emperor, Ruler'. This name was given to girls in the Roman Empire to symbolize their power and authority. The name Cassaria carries the meaning “Empress, Ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Latin. Parents who choose Cassaria usually hope their child will grow to embody empress, ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the strength and leadership qualities of God, inspiring confidence and courage in those who bear the name.
data.etymology: Cassaria belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Empress, Ruler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Cassaria total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_hebrew.name: קסריה
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נשמה של גבר, קשורה בבית-לחם,
in_hebrew.long_meaning: שם נשמה של גבר, קשורה בבית-לחם, עיר הקדומה, בית-לחם-הגליל, שבה נולד ישו, ישוע, המשיח, בעלת חשיבות רבה בנצרות, וכנסיות רבות, כגון, כנסיית הקבר, נבנו על חורבות העיר העתיקה, והיא עדיין נחשבת, כאתר קדוש, בנצרות, וכמקום, של הויכוח, הגדול ביניהם, של ישו, והשופט, פילטוס, אך, השם, הזה, ניתן, גם, לבת, אם, ישראל, ש, נקראה, קסריה, בספר, שמואל, ראות, 1:20, והיא, נותרה, עד, היום, כ, שם, נשמה, ל, נשים, ו, גברים, בנצרות

in_greek.name: Κασσαρία
in_greek.meaning: ονομασία ψυχής ανδρός, συνδεμένη με Βηθλέεμ
in_greek.long_meaning: ονομασία ψυχής ανδρός, συνδεμένη με Βηθλέεμ, παλιά πόλη, Βηθλέεμ της Γαλιλαίας, όπου γεννήθηκε ο Ιησούς, ο Χριστός, έχει μεγάλη σημασία στην orthodoxία, και πολλές εκκλησίες, όπως η Εκκλησία της Επιφανείας, χτίστηκαν πάνω από τα ερείπια της παλιάς πόλης, και παραμένει μέχρι σήμερα ως τόπος ιερού, στην orthodoxία, και ως το μέρος, του μεγάλου διαλόγου, μεταξύ του Ιησού, και του δικαστή Φίλιππος, αλλά το όνομα αυτό, δίνεται, επίσης, σε γυναίκα, που ονομάζεται Κασσαρία, στην Πράξη των Αποστόλων, και παραμένει ως όνομα, για άνδρες, και γυναίκες, στην orthodoxία

in_latin.name: Cassaria
in_latin.meaning: nomen animae viri, conexum cum Bethleem
in_latin.long_meaning: nomen animae viri, conexum cum Bethleem, urbs antiqua, Bethleem Galilaeae, ubi natus est Jesus Christus, habet magnam significatioem in Ecclesia catholica, et multae ecclesiae, ut Ecclesia Epiphaniae, constructae sunt super ruinas urbis antiquae, et manet usque hodie ut locus sanctus, in Ecclesia catholica, et ut locum magni dialogi, inter Jesus, et iudicem Philippum, sed nomen hoc, datur, etiam, mulieri, quae nomen habet Cassaria, in Actis Apostolorum, et manet usque hodie, ut nomen, virorum, et mulierum, in Ecclesia catholica

in_english.name: Cassaria
in_english.meaning: a feminine name meaning related to Bethlehem, with significance in Christianity, and also a rare masculine variant with the same meaning
in_english.long_meaning: a feminine name meaning related to Bethlehem, with significant cultural and historical importance in Christianity, particularly in the context of the Nativity of Jesus, and the city of Bethlehem, also a rare masculine variant with the same meaning, which may be associated with the Latin name Cassarius, derived from the Latin word for 'treasurer', but more likely related to the Greek word 'kasos', meaning 'shame' or 'blame', and the Hebrew word 'kasher', meaning 'pure' or 'clean', in the context of the biblical narrative, the name Cassaria may evoke the themes of purity, innocence, and redemption, and may be associated with the figure of Cassia, a biblical character, and the name may also be seen as a symbol of spiritual growth, and personal transformation, in the Christian tradition

data.cultural_impact: The name Cassaria can evoke a sense of strength, leadership, and prestige. Historically, in the Roman Empire, the name Cassarius was given to the rulers and commanders, which represents a powerful connotation.
data.spiritual_significance: Culturally derived from the Roman Empire, the name Cassaria carries with it the spiritual significance of echoing the majesty and authority of the Emperor, reminding us that we are all children of the ultimate ruler and creator, God. By bearing the name Cassaria, one is reminded of their potential to lead and rule with wisdom, kindness, and compassion as a reflection of divine power and authority.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Cassaria: A beacon of grace and strength, her name derived from the Latin word for "casseria," signifying a stronghold or fortress. In Christian tradition, Cassaria embodies the resilience of God's love and the inner fortitude that sustains us during life's trials.
